at: The second visit, she measures his shoulders with her hands.
alt: Afternoon in the Gaya house: Munhee stands behind the seated Chunchu and measures his shoulders with her bare hands, and he goes red to the ears.
scene: Romance still, intimate medium-close, low three-quarter angle. Afternoon in a plain timber hall; a paper lattice window throws one warm slanted shaft of sun across the floor. Chunchu sits cross-legged on the floor in a thin white underrobe, his magenta silk coat folded on his knees, back very straight, eyes fixed on the far wall, flushed red to the tips of his ears, lips pressed shut. Munhee stands close behind him in a pale pink jeogori and rose chima, sleeves pushed up, laying both open palms flat across his shoulders as if measuring them, a measuring cord still tucked unused in her sleeve; she is biting back a smile, looking at the back of his neck. ONE device: the window shaft falling across both of them like a sash. Dust motes as bokeh. Magenta #D8258C as the catch on his folded coat. Chunchu is bare-headed indoors: take only his FACE from the sheet — no cap, no headband, no crescent, no feathers; his black hair loose or in a low knot.

at: Neither of them lets go first.

at: He kisses her before she can put it down.
